name: pre-delivery-meeple-v1
description: ⭐ THE reference-v18 GAME, KEPT AS A CONTROL (14/09/2026). The shipped game as it stood at commit f0a0658, the day Dean ruled the Apiary retext in, BEFORE he ruled the delivery meeple ON and added the space choice and the closing draw. Six leaves, all pinned BY NAME at their pre-ruling values: rules.turn.deliveryMeepleSpace null, meepleSpendTiming 'start', meepleSpendPerTurn null and meepleSpendDistinctColours false (⛔ 'start' and null are the old INERT values, not the 'none' and 0 of section 3 of docs/village-store-coins-handoff-2026-09-12-v1.md, which would delete the v31 control's turn-start spend), rules.turn.deliverySpaceChoice false (fill order: 6 VP to the first arrival, 3 VP to the second) and rules.turn.closingDrawPerCrate 0 (no draw for filling a tile). ⭐ IT IS THE ZERO-DIFF PROOF OF THE SLICE: a --watchlist --n=1580 run of this overlay must reproduce reports/watchlist-2026-09-14T14-42-22-reference-v18.txt on every measured line, and only header, timestamp and wall-clock lines may differ. ⭐ THE THREE DECOMPOSITION ARMS ON THE NEW BASE read against it: overlays/delivery-meeple-no-choice-v1.overlay.json (the meeple alone), overlays/delivery-meeple-choice-v1.overlay.json (the meeple and the space choice) and overlays/closing-draw-only-v1.overlay.json (the closing draw alone); the shipped default is all three together. ⚠️ HOW TO RUN IT: --overlay= with --watchlist, never --sweep=, and always --n=1580 (4,820 games, five mirrors), paired on identical reference-v18 seeds. A bare --watchlist is a 1,580-game pilot and must not be quoted beside a real run.
